label: Pellicle beamsplitter

membrane_thickness.help: membrane thickness (2 um, typical pellicle film)

tooltip: Ultra-thin (few-micron) nitrocellulose membrane beamsplitter -- negligible ghosting, no wedge/etalon concerns. Front (-x) face carries the pellicle_4555_45 coating (swap to pellicle_uncoated_45 for a bare membrane).
